initialExam.title: CLAT 2026 (Common Law Admission Test)
initialExam.description: CLAT is the premier law entrance exam for admission to 24 National Law Universities (NLUs) for UG and PG law programs.
initialExam.eligibility: Class 12 pass with 45% marks (UG) or LLB with 50% (PG)
initialExam.syllabus: UG: English, GK/Current Affairs, Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude. PG: Constitutional Law, Jurisprudence.
initialExam.examPattern: UG: 150 MCQs, 120 minutes. PG: 120 MCQs, 120 minutes. Negative marking 0.25.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CLAT Score → Counselling → Seat Allotment → Admission
initialExam.jobRole: Admission to NLU for BA LLB / LLM programs leading to legal career
initialExam.careerGrowth: Law Student → Advocate → Senior Advocate → Judge / Corporate Lawyer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit consortiumofnlus.ac.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Admission to top law schools, scholarships available
